hadith.english: Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His servant than a traveller who finds his lost camel again.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: If you did not sin, Allah would replace you with a people who sin, seek forgiveness, and are forgiven.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A man who had killed ninety-nine people asked whether he could still repent, and the hadith tells us the door was open to him.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: None of you should die except while thinking well of Allah.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: No fatigue, illness, worry, grief, harm or distress touches a Muslim, even a thorn's prick, but Allah expiates some of his sins for it.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Allah says: I am just as My servant thinks I am. If he comes to Me walking, I go to him running.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet wept as his son Ibrahim was dying and said: “The eyes are shedding tears and the heart is grieved, and we will not say except what pleases our Lord.”
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Allah accepts the repentance of His servant until the soul reaches the throat.
hadith.grader: Darussalam (Tirmidhi himself calls it hasan gharib)

hadith.english: The best of believers are those who are best to their wives (summary of the narration from A’ishah).
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: The Prophet told the people of the Negus's death on the day he died, lined them up at the prayer ground and said four takbirs
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet told the women washing his daughter to wash her three or five times or more with water and lotus leaves, adding camphor at the end
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet was shrouded in three white Yemeni cotton sheets, without a shirt or a turban
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet told people to hurry with the dead body: if the person was righteous it is forwarding them to good, otherwise it is putting an evil off their necks
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Samurah ibn Jundab prayed behind the Prophet over a woman who had died in childbirth; he stood by the middle of the bier
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Talhah prayed a funeral prayer behind Ibn Abbas, who recited al-Fatihah and said it is the Prophet's tradition
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Zayd ibn Arqam usually said four takbirs over a funeral but once said five, and said the Prophet had done the same
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: 'Awf ibn Malik remembered the Prophet's du'a over a dead man: forgive him, have mercy on him, make his grave wide, wash him with water, snow and hail, admit him to Paradise and protect him from the torment of the grave and the Fire
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A man who could not learn the Qur'an was told to say glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is most great, and there is no might nor strength but in Allah
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Ibn Umar said the Prophet prayed the optional prayers on his mount facing any direction, and witr too, but never the compulsory prayer on it
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: When the Prophet set out before noon he delayed Dhuhr until Asr time and prayed them together
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Imran ibn Husayn had piles and asked about the prayer; the Prophet said pray standing, if you cannot then sitting, if you cannot then on your side
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A'ishah said the Prophet never exceeded eleven rak'ahs at night in Ramadan or other months
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Huraira reported the Prophet finished after two rak'ahs by mistake, Dhul-Yadayn pointed it out, he prayed two more, gave the salam and made two prostrations
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said the prayer of one who passes wind or urine is not accepted until he does wudu
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar said the Prophet made zakat al-fitr a sa' of dates or barley on every Muslim, and ordered it be paid before people go out to the Eid prayer
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Umar saw people praying in scattered groups in Ramadan and gathered them behind one reciter, saying what a good innovation this is
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ka'b ibn Ujrah said the companions asked the Prophet how to send blessings on him and his household; he told them to say: O Allah, send blessings on Muhammad and his family as You sent on Ibrahim and his family, You are praiseworthy and glorious; and bless Muhammad and his family as You blessed Ibrahim and his family
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas was asked if the Prophet ever prayed with his shoes on and said yes
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said whoever forgets a prayer should pray it when he remembers it, there is no expiation but that; then he recited the verse about establishing prayer for My remembrance
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ubadah ibn as-Samit reported that the Prophet said the prayer of someone who does not recite the Opening of the Book is not valid
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Buhaina reported the Prophet stood after two rak'ahs without sitting and made two prostrations before giving the salam
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Mas'ud reported that the Prophet taught the tashahhud: greetings, prayers and good words are for Allah; peace be on you O Prophet; peace on us and on Allah's righteous servants; I bear witness there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is His servant and messenger
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas said the Prophet did not go out on the day of Eid al-Fitr until he had eaten some dates, an odd number
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet prayed the Eid of Adha and Eid of Fitr, then gave the khutbah after the prayer
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said to make witr your last prayer at night
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ali said the Prophet set three days and nights for a traveller and one day and one night for a resident
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ubadah reported the same: there is no prayer for one who does not recite Fatihat al-Kitab
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Sa'id reported the Prophet said that if one is in doubt about how much he prayed he should put the doubt aside, base it on what he is sure of and make two prostrations before the salam
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet gave the time of each prayer: Fajr until the sun starts to rise, Zuhr until Asr, Asr until the sun turns yellow, Maghrib until the twilight goes, Isha until half the night
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas reported the same: he who forgets the prayer should pray it when he remembers it
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Umar asked about shortening when people were safe, and the Prophet said it is a charity Allah has given you, so accept it
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A man asked about the night prayer: it is pairs of rak'ahs, and if you fear morning is near, pray one rak'ah to make your prayer an odd number
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said from his pulpit that people must cease to neglect the Friday prayer or Allah will seal their hearts and they will be among the negligent
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Umm Habibah heard the Prophet say a house in Paradise for whoever prays twelve rak'ahs in a day and night: four before Zuhr and two after, two after Maghrib, two after Isha and two before Fajr
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Anas said the Companions used to wait for the night prayer until their heads dropped from dozing, then they prayed without making wudu
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu Qatadah let a cat drink from his wudu water and said the Prophet said it is not unclean, it is one of those that go round among you
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: The Prophet said a man who imagined he had passed wind in prayer should not leave unless he hears a sound or smells something
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas said that when the Prophet went to relieve himself, he and another boy followed with a tumbler full of water
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said that when anyone goes to the lavatory he should neither touch his penis nor clean his private parts with his right hand
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Uthman called for water, washed his hands three times, rinsed his mouth and nose, washed his face and arms to the elbows three times, wiped his head and washed his feet to the ankles three times, and said the Prophet taught that whoever does wudu like this and prays two rak'ahs with full attention is forgiven his earlier sins
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said if a dog drinks from a vessel of one of you he must wash it seven times
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said a woman does not pray and does not fast when menstruating
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A Bedouin urinated in the mosque and the Prophet told them to leave him, then pour a bucket of water over the place, and said they were sent to make things easy
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha described the Prophet's bath after janabah: he washed his hands, made wudu as for prayer, ran wet fingers through the roots of his hair, poured three handfuls of water on his head, and then poured water over the rest of his body
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Umm Sulaim asked if a woman needs a bath after a wet dream, and the Prophet said yes, if she notices a discharge
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said among five things given to him: the earth was made for him and his followers a place for prayer and a means of tayammum, so a person can pray wherever the time of prayer comes
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ammar told Umar that the Prophet said it would have been enough to strike the earth with his hands, blow in them, then wipe his face and hands
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Salman said the Prophet forbade facing the qibla at the time of excretion or urination, cleaning with the right hand or with fewer than three pebbles, or with dung or bone
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A'ishah said that in the time of the Prophet the women who had their courses were ordered to make up the fasts but not the prayers
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A man asked the Prophet about wudu after mutton, and he said do it if you wish, and asked about camel meat and he said yes, do wudu
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Safwan ibn Assal reported the Prophet told them on a journey not to remove their socks for three days and nights except for janabah, but not for defecating, urinating or sleep
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: The Prophet is reported to have said the menstruating woman and the one in janabah do not recite anything of the Qur'an
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Anas said the Prophet used to break his fast with fresh dates before praying, or dry dates, or a few mouthfuls of water
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Ibn Umar reported the Prophet said when he broke his fast: thirst has gone, the veins are moist and the reward is sure if Allah wills
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: The Prophet told Laqit ibn Saburah to snuff water up freely unless he is fasting
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: The Prophet said whoever does not give up forged speech and evil actions, Allah has no need of his leaving his food and drink
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said to take suhoor as there is a blessing in it
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha said the Prophet used to kiss and embrace his wives while fasting and he had more control over his desires than any of you
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said that if somebody eats or drinks forgetfully he should complete his fast, for Allah gave him what he ate or drank
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A man told the Prophet he was ruined because he had relations with his wife while fasting; the Prophet asked if he could free a slave, then fast two months, then feed sixty poor people
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said the people will remain on the right path as long as they hasten the breaking of the fast
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said that if it were not hard on his followers he would have ordered the siwak for every prayer
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Qatadah reported the Prophet was asked about fasting; he said he hoped fasting Arafah would atone for the preceding and coming year and fasting Ashura for the preceding year
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Ayyub reported the Prophet said whoever fasted Ramadan and followed it with six days of Shawwal, it is as if he fasted perpetually
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said there is no zakat on less than five awaq of silver, nor on less than five camels or five wasqs of produce
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar said the Prophet made one sa' of dates or barley incumbent on everyone as zakat al-fitr, and the people then substituted half a sa' of wheat
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said whoever performs Hajj for Allah's pleasure and avoids sexual relations and sins returns as if born anew
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said Umrah is an expiation for the sins committed between it and the previous one, and the reward of an accepted Hajj is nothing except Paradise
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas reported the Prophet said a woman should not travel except with a mahram, and a man got up to say his wife was going for Hajj and he had enlisted for a battle, so the Prophet told him to go with his wife
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet told the people Allah had made Hajj obligatory; a man asked if it was every year, and he kept quiet three times and then said that had he said yes it would have been obligatory
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas reported the Prophet said no one should be alone with a woman except when a mahram is with her, and the woman should not travel except with a mahram
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Jabir said the Prophet cursed the accepter of interest, its payer, the one who records it and the two witnesses, and said they are all equal
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A man asked the Prophet whether they could do wudu with sea water; he said its water is pure and what dies in it is lawful food
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu Talha heard the Prophet say angels of mercy do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a picture of a living creature
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said a woman entered the Fire because of a cat which she had tied, neither giving it food nor setting it free to eat from the vermin of the earth
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said whoever keeps a dog that is neither a watch dog nor a hunting dog will get a daily deduction of two qirat from his good deeds
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Amir or Abu Malik al-Ash'ari heard the Prophet say that some of his followers will treat as lawful fornication, silk, wine and musical instruments
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar reported the Prophet said to differ from the polytheists, let the beard grow and trim the moustache
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said Allah has cursed the lady who lengthens hair artificially or has it lengthened, and the one who tattoos or gets tattooed
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha said Abu Bakr protested at two girls singing in her house, and the Prophet said leave them, for there is an Eid for every people and this is our Eid
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar reported the Prophet said every intoxicant is khamr and every intoxicant is forbidden, and whoever drinks wine in this world and dies addicted to it without repenting will not be given a drink in the Hereafter
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Jabir reported that Abu Quhafah came on the day of the conquest with hair white like hyssop, and the Prophet told them to change it with something but avoid black
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Some of the wives of the Prophet reported the Prophet said whoever goes to a diviner and asks him about anything, his prayer will not be accepted for forty nights
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Mu'awiyah al-Qushayri asked what is the wife's right over her husband; the Prophet said to feed her when you eat, clothe her when you clothe yourself, not strike her on the face and not revile her
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Thawban reported the Prophet said if any woman asks her husband for divorce without a strong reason, the odour of Paradise will be forbidden to her
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: The Prophet said command a boy to pray when he reaches the age of seven years, and when he becomes ten, beat him for prayer
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: An-Nu'man ibn Bashir said his father gave him a gift, and the Prophet asked whether he had given the like of it to every one of his sons
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: It is not permissible for a man to be alone with a woman
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said a woman is married for four things: her wealth, her family status, her beauty and her religion, so marry the religious one
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said a matron should not be given in marriage without consulting her, and a virgin not without her permission, which is her silence
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: None of you should flog his wife as he flogs a slave and then have sexual intercourse with her in the last part of the day
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The wife of Thabit ibn Qais said she did not blame him for his character or religion but disliked behaving in an un-Islamic manner if she stayed with him, and the Prophet asked her to give back the garden and told Thabit to accept it
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A man asked the Prophet who is more entitled to the best companionship, and he said your mother three times and then your father
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Whoever is not merciful to others will not be treated mercifully
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said no obedience for evil deeds, obedience is required only in what is good
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Samurah reported the Messenger of Allah forbade celibacy
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: The best of you is the one who is best to his wife, and I am the best of you to my wives
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: The Prophet said do not beat the female slaves of Allah, and later said that seventy women had come to the family of Muhammad complaining about their husbands, and that those men are not the best of you
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Abu Huraira reported the Prophet said act kindly towards women, and a believing man should not hate a believing woman: if he dislikes one of her characteristics, he will be pleased with another
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A'isha reported that the Prophet never beat anyone with his hand, neither a woman nor a servant, except when fighting in the cause of Allah
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Huraira reported the Prophet said let him be humbled into dust, he who sees his parents in old age but does not enter Paradise
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Jahimah asked to go out and fight and the Prophet asked if he had a mother, and told him to stay with her, for Paradise is beneath her feet
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Thabit ibn Qais hit his wife and broke her arm, and the Prophet sent for him and told him to take what she owed him and let her go
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu Musa narrated the Messenger of Allah said there is no marriage except with a wali
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Abu Hurairah narrated the Prophet said the most complete of the believers in faith is the one with the best character, and the best of you are those who are best to your women
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: In the farewell Hajj the Prophet told the people to be good to women, and if they commit clear misconduct, to abandon their beds and beat them with a beating that is not harmful
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abdullah reported the Prophet wore a gold ring, then threw it away when people copied him and wore a silver ring instead
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas reported the Messenger of Allah saw a man wearing a gold signet ring, pulled it off and threw it away, saying one of you wishes for a live coal from Hell and puts it on his hand
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Musa reported the Messenger of Allah said wearing silk and gold has been made unlawful for the males of my Ummah and lawful for its females
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: A'isha reported the Prophet said the best of condiments is vinegar
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas reported a time limit was prescribed for clipping the moustache, cutting the nails, plucking the hair under the armpits and shaving the pubes, that it should not be neglected for more than forty nights
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Qays ibn Asim came to the Prophet intending to embrace Islam, and the Prophet commanded him to take a bath with water boiled with the leaves of the lote tree
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Ali ibn Abi Talib narrated the Prophet said if only one day of this time remained, Allah would raise up a man from my family who would fill this earth with justice as it has been filled with oppression
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Al-Miqdam ibn Ma'dikarib narrated the Prophet said I have been given the Qur'an and something like it, yet the time is coming when a man replete on his couch will say keep to the Qur'an, what you find in it permissible treat as permissible, and what you find prohibited treat as prohibited
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Amr reported a man asked the Prophet which deeds of Islam are good, and he said to feed the poor and greet those whom you know and those whom you do not know
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha said the Prophet died while his iron armor was mortgaged to a Jew for thirty sa of barley
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha said the revelation began with true dreams, then he loved seclusion and used to worship in the cave of Hira, and returned to Khadijah
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha asked the Prophet about the hardest day and he said it was the day at Aqaba when he went to Ibn Abd Yalil and he did not respond, and the angel of the mountains offered to let two mountains fall on them, and he said no, hoping Allah would bring from them those who worship Allah alone
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Huraira reported the Prophet said, by Him in whose hands is my soul, the son of Mary will soon descend among you and judge mankind justly
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Dhar reported the Prophet described how Jibreel opened his chest and washed it with Zamzam, ascended with him through the heavens, and Allah enjoined fifty prayers, which were reduced to five, and Allah said they are equal to fifty in reward
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah reported the Prophet said the best people are those living in my generation, and then those who will follow them, and then those who will follow the latter
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas said the Prophet started receiving the Divine Inspiration at the age of forty, stayed in Makkah for thirteen years, was ordered to migrate, lived as an emigrant for ten years and died at sixty-three
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Al-Bara said they used to say that the warriors of Badr were over three hundred and ten, as many as the companions of Saul who crossed the river with him
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Umar ibn Abi Salama said the Prophet told him to mention the name of Allah, eat with his right hand and eat from what is nearest to him
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar reported the Prophet said Islam is based on five: to testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Muhammad is Allah's Messenger, to offer prayer, to pay zakat, to perform Hajj, and to fast in Ramadan
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas ibn Malik narrated the Prophet said seeking knowledge is a duty upon every Muslim
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Amr ibn al-As reported the Prophet asked him, Are you not aware that Islam wipes out all the previous misdeeds?
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas reported the Prophet said he was brought al-Buraq, mounted it and came to the Temple in Jerusalem, tethered it to the ring used by the prophets, entered the mosque and prayed two rak'ahs
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Umar reported that on the day of Badr the Prophet cast a glance at the polytheists, who were one thousand, while his own companions were three hundred and nineteen, then turned towards the qiblah and made du'a to his Lord
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas reported the Messenger of Allah died when he was sixty-three years old, and so did Abu Bakr and Umar
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A'isha reported the Prophet said the angels were created from light, the jinn from the spark of fire, and Adam from what has been described to you
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said that iman is to affirm your faith in Allah, in His angels, in His Books, in His Messengers, in the Day of Judgment, and to affirm your faith in the divine decree about good and evil
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdur-Rahman ibn Awf narrated the Prophet said Abu Bakr is in Paradise, Umar is in Paradise, Uthman is in Paradise, Ali is in Paradise, Talhah, az-Zubayr, Abdur-Rahman ibn Awf, Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas, Sa'id ibn Zayd and Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah are in Paradise
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu Sa'id narrated the Messenger of Allah said Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn are the chiefs of the youths of Paradise
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Ibn Umar reported that in some of the Prophet's battles a woman was found killed, so the Messenger of Allah forbade the killing of women and children
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Amr reported the Prophet said whoever killed a person having a treaty with the Muslims shall not smell the smell of Paradise
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said Allah is more merciful to His slaves than this lady is to her son
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Buraida reported the Messenger of Allah said he who played Nardashir, a game similar to backgammon, is like one who dyed his hand with the flesh and blood of swine
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Tariq ibn Shihab: the Friday prayer in congregation is a duty on every Muslim, except a slave, a woman, a boy and a sick person.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: a surah of thirty verses, Surah al-Mulk, will intercede for its reader until he is forgiven.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Ali: Allah is single (witr) and loves what is single, so pray the witr, you people of the Qur'an.
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Al-Hasan ibn Ali: the Prophet taught him words to say in the witr supplication, beginning "O Allah, guide me among those You have guided".
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Ali: if religion went by opinion, wiping the underside of the shoe would be more fitting than the top, but he saw the Prophet wipe the top of his shoes.
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Busrah bint Safwan: the Prophet said whoever touches his private part should make wudu.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: to a man on his marriage the Prophet said "May Allah bless for you, bless upon you, and bring you together in good".
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Samurah: a boy is held in pledge for his aqiqah, which is sacrificed for him on the seventh day, with his head shaved and a name given.
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas: whoever visits a sick person whose time has not come and says seven times "I ask Allah, the Mighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to cure you", Allah will cure him.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: the Prophet's supplication at a funeral prayer, asking forgiveness for the living and the dead and for life in faith and death in Islam.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu ad-Darda: whoever travels a road seeking knowledge, Allah makes a road to Paradise easy for him, and the angels lower their wings for the seeker of knowledge.
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Salman al-Farsi: the blessing of food is in washing before and after it. Abu Dawud himself says this report is weak.
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Wahshi ibn Harb: the Companions said they ate and were not satisfied; the Prophet told them to eat together and mention Allah's name, and they would be blessed in it.
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Aisha: when one of you eats he should mention Allah's name; if he forgets at the start, he should say "In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end".
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu Said al-Khudri: after finishing food the Prophet said "Praise be to Allah who fed us, gave us drink and made us Muslims".
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Aisha: the Prophet told Asma that once a woman reaches maturity nothing should be seen of her except her face and hands. Abu Dawud notes the chain is broken (mursal).
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: whoever does not thank people is not thankful to Allah.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu ad-Darda: on the Day of Resurrection you will be called by your names and your fathers' names, so give yourselves good names.
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Amr: command your children to pray at seven, discipline them for it at ten, and separate their beds.
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Hafsah: when going to sleep the Prophet put his right hand under his cheek and said three times "O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day You raise Your servants".
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Uthman ibn Affan: whoever says three times "In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing", will not be struck by sudden affliction that morning or evening.
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Anas: when a man leaves his house and says "In the name of Allah, I trust in Allah, there is no might or power but with Allah", it is said to him "You are guided, defended and protected".
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Abu Malik al-Ashari: on entering his home a man should say the supplication "O Allah, I ask You for the good of entering and leaving; in Allah's name we enter and leave and on Allah our Lord we rely", and then greet his family.
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Abu Rafi: he saw the Prophet give the call to prayer in the ear of al-Hasan ibn Ali when Fatimah gave birth to him.
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Umar ibn al-Khattab: deeds are judged by intentions, and each person gets what he intended; the emigration for Allah and His Messenger differs from one made for worldly gain or a woman.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: when the Prophet saw rain he would say "O Allah, make it a beneficial downpour".
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ali: the Prophet said "Do not tell lies about me, for whoever lies about me will enter the Fire".
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: the Prophet prayed at night in the mosque and people joined him; after a few nights he stayed away, fearing that the prayer would become obligatory for them.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Jabir: the Prophet taught the istikhara prayer for all matters, two rak'ahs followed by the supplication "O Allah, I seek Your guidance by Your knowledge".
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Zaynab bint Abi Salama, quoting the Prophet: a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day may not mourn more than three days for the dead, except four months and ten days for a husband.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas: the Prophet said real patience is at the first stroke of a calamity.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: whoever attends a funeral until he prays over the dead gets one qirat of reward, and whoever stays until burial gets two, each like a great mountain.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: every child is born on the fitrah, and his parents make him a Jew, a Christian or a Magian.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas: the Prophet sent Mu'adh to Yemen and told him to call people to the testimony of faith, then to the five daily prayers, then to zakat, taken from their rich and given to their poor.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: the Prophet said that wealth whose zakat is not paid will on the Day of Resurrection become a bald, venomous snake that coils round its owner's neck; he then recited Qur'an 3:180.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Adi ibn Hatim: the Prophet said to protect yourselves from the Fire even with half a date given in charity.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Hakim ibn Hizam: the upper hand (giving) is better than the lower (taking); start with your dependents; the best charity is from what is left after your needs; and whoever avoids begging, Allah makes him self-sufficient.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas: the Prophet told an Ansari woman who had been unable to perform Hajj with him that Umrah in Ramadan equals Hajj in reward.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: fast when you see the new moon of Ramadan, stop fasting when you see the new moon of Shawwal, and if it is cloudy complete thirty days of Shaban.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas: the Prophet found the Jews of Madinah fasting on Ashura, the day Allah saved the Children of Israel; he said "We have more right to Musa than you", fasted it and told the Muslims to fast it.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: the Prophet said to look for Laylat al-Qadr in the odd nights of the last ten days of Ramadan.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Umar: the Prophet used to practise i'tikaf in the last ten days of Ramadan.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: the Prophet used to make i'tikaf for ten days each Ramadan, and in the year he died he stayed twenty days.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: Fatima bint Abi Hubaysh asked whether she should stop praying because of continuous bleeding; the Prophet said it was from a vein, not menstruation, so she should leave prayer only for her real period, then wash and pray.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: while he guarded the zakat of Ramadan a thief came; he released him twice; the third time the thief taught him to recite Ayat al-Kursi at night for Allah's protection, and the Prophet said he had told the truth.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas: no Muslim plants a tree or sows a field and then a bird, person or animal eats from it, except that it counts as charity for him.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: whoever keeps a dog loses one qirat of his reward every day, unless it is for guarding crops or livestock, or for hunting.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: a man gave water to a thirsty dog and Allah thanked him for it and forgave him; the people asked whether there is reward in serving animals, and he said there is a reward in every living creature.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Al-Bara: the Prophet told him that at bedtime he should make wudu as for prayer, lie on his right side and say the supplication beginning "O Allah, I submit myself to You"; if he dies that night he dies in faith, on Islam.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Bakrah: the Prophet named the greatest sins as associating partners with Allah and disobeying parents, and then warned repeatedly against false witness.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: whoever introduces into this matter of ours something that is not part of it, it is rejected.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: Allah has ninety-nine names, one hundred less one, and whoever learns them will enter Paradise.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Sad ibn Abi Waqqas: when ill he asked to bequeath his property; the Prophet refused half, allowed a third and said even a third is a lot, and that leaving his heirs well-off is better than leaving them poor.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Amr: asked which part of Islam is best, the Prophet said to feed people and to greet those you know and those you do not know.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: she began her period on the way to Hajj; the Prophet told her to do everything the pilgrims do except the tawaf round the Kaaba.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Said al-Khudri: at the Eid prayer the Prophet told the women to give charity, said most of the people he had seen in Hell were women because of frequent cursing and ingratitude to husbands, and explained their "deficiency in religion" as not praying or fasting during their period.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: the Prophet told Fatima bint Abi Hubaysh, who had bleeding outside her period, to leave the prayer during her real period, then wash the blood off and pray.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Masud: a person is gathered in the mother's womb for forty days, then a clot, then a piece of flesh, each for forty days, and then an angel is sent to write his provision, lifespan, deeds and whether he will be wretched or happy.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Muadha: Aisha said that women in the Prophet's time who had their period were not told to make up the prayers they missed.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: Allah says "I have prepared for My righteous servants what no eye has seen, no ear has heard and no human heart has imagined".
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: magic was worked on the Prophet so that he imagined doing things he had not done; Allah told him in a dream who did it and how, and he was cured.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: Satan comes to one of you asking who created this and that, until he asks who created your Lord; when that happens, seek refuge in Allah and stop.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Safiyyah: when two Ansari men passed as the Prophet walked her home, he told them it was his wife Safiyyah, adding that Satan moves in a person like blood and he feared a doubt would be cast into their hearts.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Qatadah: a good dream is from Allah and a disturbing one from Satan; whoever has a bad dream should spit lightly to his left and seek refuge in Allah from its evil, and it will not harm him.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: the signs of a hypocrite are three: when he speaks he lies, when he promises he breaks it, and when he is trusted he betrays.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas: part of the story of Hajar and Ismail at Makkah, her running between Safa and Marwa and the coming of Zamzam; the Prophet said if she had let it flow it would have been a running spring.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Amr: the Prophet said the most beloved fasting to Allah is that of Dawud, who fasted every other day, and the most beloved prayer is Dawud's, who slept half the night, prayed a third and slept a sixth.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Imran ibn Husayn: on a journey the people slept through the dawn prayer; a man in need of a major wash was told to do tayammum with clean earth and told it was enough for him, and later water was brought for him to pour over himself.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Amr: convey from me even one verse, and relate from the Children of Israel, there is no harm in it; but whoever deliberately lies about me, let him take his seat in the Fire.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: whoever fasts Ramadan with faith and hoping for reward, his past sins are forgiven.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Masud al-Badri: the last two verses of Surat al-Baqarah, recited at night, are enough for him.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Masud: when the Prophet prayed more than usual and was told, he made two prostrations (sujud as-sahw) and said he is a human being who forgets as they do.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas: the verse allowing those able to fast to feed a poor person instead (2:184) is not cancelled; it is for old men and women who cannot fast, who feed one poor person for each day.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas: "Allah is sufficient for us and the best Disposer of affairs" was said by Ibrahim when thrown into the fire and by Muhammad when told that people had gathered against them.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: the one who is skilled in reciting the Qur'an is with the noble, obedient angels, and the one who recites with difficulty and effort has a double reward.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Zayd ibn Thabit: after many reciters died at Yamama, Umar urged Abu Bakr to have the Qur'an collected, and Abu Bakr asked Zayd to gather it from written pieces and from memory.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: the angel Jibril asked the Prophet about faith, Islam and ihsan, and the Prophet explained each; Islam is worshipping Allah alone, the prayer, zakat and fasting Ramadan.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Masud: whoever recites the last two verses of Surat al-Baqarah at night, they will be enough for him.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Said al-Khudri: a man kept repeating Surat al-Ikhlas and thought it little; the Prophet said, by Him in whose hand is my soul, it is equal to a third of the Qur'an.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: each night at bedtime the Prophet cupped his hands, blew into them after reciting Ikhlas, Falaq and Nas, and wiped over his body three times.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Uthman: the best among you are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Umar: if any of you is invited to a wedding feast, he should attend.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Asma bint Abi Bakr: she gave birth to Abdullah ibn az-Zubayr at Quba; the Prophet chewed a date, put it in the baby's mouth (tahnik) and prayed for blessing for him.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: if Allah wants good for someone, He afflicts him with trials.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Musa: whoever prays the two cool prayers, Asr and Fajr, will enter Paradise.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: the effect of the evil eye is real, and the Prophet forbade tattooing.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: Labid ibn al-Asam of Banu Zuraiq worked magic on the Prophet so that he imagined doing things he had not done; Allah told him what had been done and how, and he was healed.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: five things are of the fitrah: circumcision, shaving the pubic hair, clipping the nails, plucking the underarm hair and trimming the moustache.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: the Prophet tore down a curtain with pictures and said those who imitate Allah's creation will be punished most severely on the Day of Resurrection.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas: the Prophet was the most generous of people, and most generous in Ramadan when Jibril met him each night to review the Qur'an with him.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: An-Numan ibn Bashir: believers in their mutual mercy, love and kindness are like one body; if one part complains, the whole body shares the sleeplessness and fever.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Jarir ibn Abdullah: whoever is not merciful to people, Allah is not merciful to him.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: the Prophet said Jibril kept advising him to be kind to the neighbour until he thought he would make the neighbour an heir.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar: the Prophet said Jibril kept advising him to be kind to the neighbour until he thought he would make the neighbour an heir.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not harm his neighbour, should honour his guest, and should say what is good or keep silent.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Masud: truthfulness leads to righteousness and righteousness leads to Paradise; lying leads to wickedness and wickedness leads to the Fire.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: the strong person is not the one who overpowers others but the one who controls himself in anger.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Jabir: whoever says the supplication after the call to prayer ("O Allah, Lord of this perfect call...") will be granted the Prophet's intercession on the Day of Resurrection.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: when one of you sneezes he should say "Praise be to Allah"; his brother replies "May Allah have mercy on you", and he answers "May Allah guide you and set your affairs right".
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Shaddad ibn Aws: the best way of asking forgiveness (sayyid al-istighfar) is "O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You..."; whoever says it with certainty by day and dies before evening will be among the people of Paradise.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas: Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His servant than one of you is on finding his lost camel in the desert.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Malik ibn al-Huwayrith: after staying twenty days with the Prophet, the young men were told to return to their families, teach them, and "pray as you have seen me pray".
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Hudhayfah: at bedtime the Prophet said "In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live", and on waking "Praise be to Allah who gave us life after He caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection".
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas: the Prophet used to seek refuge in Allah from worry and grief, incapacity and laziness, cowardice and miserliness, heavy debt and being overpowered by men.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: wealth is not having many possessions; real wealth is contentment of the soul.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Umar: prayer in congregation is twenty-seven times better than the prayer of a person alone.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Amr ibn al-As: when a judge strives and gets it right he has two rewards, and if he strives and errs he has one.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar: the Prophet said all of you are guardians and each is responsible for those under his care.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar: the Prophet said do not stop Allah's female servants from going to Allah's mosques; a wife of Umar used to attend the Fajr and Isha prayers for this reason.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: the Prophet spoke of Friday and said there is an hour in it in which a Muslim who prays and asks Allah for something will be given it, and he indicated with his hand that it is short.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: on Eid two girls were singing the songs of Buath in her house; Abu Bakr objected but the Prophet said to leave them, because every people has a festival and this is ours.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Jabir: on the day of Eid the Prophet used to return by a different road from the one he went by.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar: the night prayer is two rak'ahs at a time, and whoever fears the dawn should pray one rak'ah to make the prayers odd.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: marriage is part of my sunnah; whoever lacks the means should fast, for it reduces desire.
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: learn the rules of inheritance and teach them, for they are half of knowledge and will be forgotten. (Graded weak.)
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Jabir: the water of Zamzam is for whatever it is drunk for.
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: whoever takes up arms against us is not one of us, and whoever deceives us is not one of us.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: Allah is good and accepts only what is good; He commanded the believers to eat of the good things, and a person whose food and drink are unlawful will not have his prayer answered.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: richness is not having many possessions; true richness is richness of the soul.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas: take the pre-dawn meal (suhur), for there is blessing in it.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Sahl ibn Sad: people will continue to do well as long as they hasten to break the fast.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas: the Prophet fasted Ashura and told people to fast it; when told the Jews and Christians honour it, he said that next year, if Allah wills, they would fast the ninth too, but he died before the next year.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: the best fast after Ramadan is in Allah's month of Muharram, and the best prayer after the obligatory prayers is the night prayer.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: look for Laylat al-Qadr in the last ten nights of Ramadan.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: the Prophet used to make i'tikaf in the last ten days of Ramadan until Allah took him, and his wives did so after him.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Jabir: the long account of the Prophet's Farewell Pilgrimage, from leaving Madinah through the rites at Arafat, Muzdalifah, Mina and the Kaaba.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: if people keep asking until they ask "Allah created all things, so who created Allah?", whoever meets this should say "I believe in Allah" and stop.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar: when setting out on a journey the Prophet said "Allahu akbar" three times and then the travel supplication "Glory to Him who subjected this to us".
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: one Umrah to the next wipes out what is between them, and an accepted Hajj has no reward but Paradise.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: whoever performs Hajj and does not speak indecently or disobey returns free of sin, as on the day his mother bore him.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar: when any of you is invited to a feast he should accept.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar: whoever keeps a dog other than one for herding or hunting loses two qirats of his reward every day.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar: Islam is built on five: that Allah is One (worship of Allah alone), establishing the prayer, paying zakat, fasting Ramadan and the pilgrimage to the House.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Amr ibn al-As: when a judge strives to reach the right judgment and is right he has two rewards, and if he errs he has one reward.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: whoever does an act that is not in accordance with our matter (the religion), it is rejected.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Amr: those who are just will be on pulpits of light beside Allah, those who are fair in their rule, their families and what they are responsible for.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar: every one of you is a shepherd and answerable for his flock: the ruler, the man for his family, the woman for her husband's home, and the servant for his master's property.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Umar ibn al-Khattab: actions are judged by intentions, and each person gets what he intended; emigration for Allah and His Messenger is for them, and emigration for worldly gain or a woman is for that.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Hudhayfah: Satan makes lawful the food over which Allah's name has not been mentioned; the Prophet seized the hands of a girl and a bedouin who reached for the food before he began.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Jabir: when a man mentions Allah's name on entering his house and while eating, Satan says there is no lodging or supper here for you; if he does not, Satan finds both.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Masud: the people who will be most severely punished on the Day of Resurrection are the makers of pictures.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Samurah ibn Jundub: the dearest words to Allah are four, SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illa Allah and Allahu akbar; and do not name your servants Yasar, Rabah, Najih or Aflah.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas: when two men passed as the Prophet walked with his wife, he told them who she was and said Satan moves through a person like blood.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: the influence of the evil eye is real.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas: the evil eye is real; if anything could overtake destiny it would be the evil eye, and when you are asked to wash, wash.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: Labid ibn al-Asam, of Banu Zuraiq, cast a spell on the Prophet so that he imagined doing things he had not done; Allah showed him in a dream what had been done and he was healed.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Uthman ibn Abi al-As: he complained of a pain in his body; the Prophet told him to place his hand on the place, say "Bismillah" three times and seven times "I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I find and fear".
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Malik al-Ashari: cleanliness is half of faith, "Alhamdulillah" fills the scale, prayer is light, charity is proof, patience is illumination, and the Qur'an is an argument for you or against you.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar: the Prophet said no prayer is accepted without purification, and no charity from stolen booty.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Qatadah: a good dream is from Allah and a disliked dream from Satan; whoever sees one he dislikes should spit to his left three times and seek refuge in Allah from its evil, and it will not harm him.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Uthman ibn Affan: whoever performs wudu well, his sins come out of his body, even from under his fingernails.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: had it not been a hardship for the believers, the Prophet would have ordered them to use the toothstick at every prayer.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Thawban: whoever visits a sick person remains in the fruit-garden of Paradise until he returns.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: five things are of the fitrah: circumcision, shaving the pubic hair, clipping the nails, plucking the underarm hair and trimming the moustache.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: An-Numan ibn Bashir: believers in mutual love, mercy and compassion are like one body; when one limb aches the whole body responds with sleeplessness and fever.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: charity does not decrease wealth; Allah increases in honour the one who forgives, and raises the one who is humble for His sake.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: backbiting is mentioning your brother in a way he dislikes; if what you say is true it is backbiting, and if it is false it is slander.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar: the Prophet said to trim the moustache closely and let the beard grow.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Umm Kulthum bint Uqba: the Prophet said the one who reconciles people by speaking good or conveying good is not a liar.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Masud: truthfulness leads to righteousness and righteousness to Paradise; lying leads to wickedness and wickedness to the Fire.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: the strong man is not the one who wrestles well, but the one who controls himself when angry.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar: Jibril kept urging the Prophet to be kind to the neighbour until he thought he would make the neighbour an heir.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Masud: a person's constituents are gathered for forty days in the womb, then a clot for forty days, then a lump of flesh for forty days; then an angel is sent to write provision, lifespan, deeds and whether he will be wretched or happy.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: a strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than a weak one, yet both have good; strive for what benefits you, seek Allah's help, and do not say "if only" when misfortune comes.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah, reporting Allah's words: "I am as My servant thinks of Me, and I am with him when he remembers Me"; whoever draws near by a hand-span, Allah draws near by an arm's length.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Mus'ab ibn Sad: the Prophet asked whether any of you cannot earn a thousand good deeds a day; whoever says "SubhanAllah" a hundred times has a thousand good deeds recorded or a thousand sins wiped away.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Al-Bara ibn Azib: at bedtime make wudu as for prayer, lie on your right side and say the supplication "O Allah, I submit my face to You"; if you die that night you die upon the fitrah (Islam).
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Al-Bara: at bedtime the Prophet said "In Your name, O Allah, I live and die", and on waking "Praise be to Allah who gave us life after He caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection".
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Masud: everyone has a companion from the jinn assigned to him; the Prophet said he too has one, but Allah helped him against it, so it only commands him to good.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah, reporting Allah's words: "I have prepared for My righteous servants what no eye has seen, no ear has heard and no heart has imagined."
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: the Companions heard a great crash; the Prophet said it was a stone thrown into Hell seventy years ago which had just reached the bottom.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Suhayb: the believer's affair is all good: if good befalls him he is grateful and that is good for him, and if harm befalls him he is patient and that is good for him.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: if one of you feels something in his stomach and is unsure whether anything has come out, he should not leave the mosque unless he hears a sound or smells something.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Amr: when you hear the muadhdhin, repeat what he says, then send blessings on me and ask Allah for the wasila (a rank in Paradise) for me; whoever asks it for me, my intercession is guaranteed for him.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: whoever sends blessings on me once, Allah sends blessings on him ten times.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar: when your women ask permission to go to the mosque, do not prevent them.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or keep silent, be kind to his neighbour and honour his guest.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: you will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another; the Prophet recommended spreading the greeting of peace to foster that love.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Masud: the Prophet prayed and was told something in the prayer was different; he turned to the qibla, made two prostrations and ended with the salam, saying he was a human who forgets.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: after the final tashahhud seek refuge in Allah from four things: the punishment of Hell, the punishment of the grave, the trial of life and death, and the trial of the Antichrist (Dajjal).
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: the signs of a hypocrite are three: when he speaks he lies, when he promises he breaks it, and when he is trusted he betrays.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar: prayer in congregation is twenty-seven degrees more excellent than prayer said alone.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Uthman ibn Affan: whoever prays Isha in congregation is as if he prayed half the night, and whoever prays Fajr in congregation is as if he prayed the whole night.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Usayd: on entering the mosque say "O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy", and on leaving say "O Allah, I ask You for Your bounty".
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: the Prophet prayed in the mosque at night and people joined him on successive nights; he stayed away on the third or fourth night, fearing the prayer would become obligatory for them.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: the one who recites the Qur'an skilfully is with the noble, obedient angels, and the one who falters and finds it hard has a double reward.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Umamah: recite the Qur'an, for on the Day of Resurrection it will come as an intercessor for its reciters; recite al-Baqarah and Al Imran, which will come like clouds or flocks of birds pleading for their reciters.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Masud: whoever recites the last two verses of Surat al-Baqarah at night, they will be enough for him.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Jabir: the Prophet's Friday sermon, in which he said the best speech is the Book of Allah, the best guidance is the guidance of Muhammad, and the worst of matters are those newly invented.
