hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abd ar-Rahman ibn Abi Bakrah: the Prophet named the gravest sins as associating partners with Allah, disobedience to parents, and false testimony or false speech.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: on Eid two girls sang songs of Buath at her house; Abu Bakr objected but the Prophet said every people has a festival and this is ours.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: when a wind or dark cloud came the Prophet was uneasy, fearing it might be punishment for his people, and he was relieved when it rained.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Umm Salamah: whoever is struck by a calamity and says "We belong to Allah and to Him we return; O Allah, reward me in my affliction and give me something better", Allah gives him something better.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas: patience is at the first blow; the Prophet told a woman weeping for her child to fear Allah and be patient.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: make haste with the funeral; if the dead person was righteous you are sending him to good, and if not you are putting an evil from your necks.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Buraydah: the Prophet said he had forbidden visiting graves but now allowed it, and lifted earlier restrictions on keeping sacrificial meat and on certain drinking vessels, while intoxicants stay forbidden.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hatim al-Muzani: when someone whose religion and character you are pleased with proposes, marry him (your daughter or ward) to him, otherwise there will be turmoil and corruption in the land.
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Umar: whoever drinks intoxicants, his prayer is not accepted for forty days; if he repents Allah accepts his repentance.
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Amr: the merciful are shown mercy by Ar-Rahman; be merciful to those on earth and the One above the heavens will be merciful to you; whoever keeps the ties of kinship, Allah keeps ties with him.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu Dharr: smiling in your brother's face is charity, enjoining good and forbidding evil is charity, guiding a lost man, removing a stone or thorn from the road, and pouring from your bucket into your brother's bucket are charity.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: remember often the destroyer of pleasures, meaning death.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Umar ibn al-Khattab: if you relied on Allah as He should be relied on, He would provide for you as He provides for the birds, which go out hungry in the morning and return full.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: the Prophet told Ubayy ibn Kab that nothing like Surat al-Fatihah has been revealed in the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms or the Qur'an.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Anas: everything has a heart and the heart of the Qur'an is Ya Sin; whoever recites it, Allah writes for him the reward of reciting the Qur'an ten times. (Graded weak.)
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas: a Companion heard someone reciting Surat al-Mulk from a grave; the Prophet said it is the defender and the deliverer from the punishment of the grave. (Graded weak.)
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: there is a surah of thirty verses that intercedes for its reciter until he is forgiven, Tabarak, Surat al-Mulk.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Masud: whoever recites a letter from Allah's Book gets a good deed, and each good deed is multiplied by ten; Alif is a letter, Lam is a letter and Mim is a letter.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: An-Numan ibn Bashir: the Prophet said supplication (dua) is worship, and recited "Call upon Me, I will respond to you" (Qur'an 40:60).
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Uthman ibn Affan: whoever says three times morning and evening "In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can harm, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing", nothing will harm him.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Umar: whoever sees a person afflicted and says "Praise be to Allah who saved me from what He tested you with and favoured me over many of His creation", will be spared that affliction. (Graded weak.)
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Talhah ibn Ubaydullah: on seeing the new moon the Prophet said "O Allah, bring it over us with blessing and faith, with safety and Islam; my Lord and your Lord is Allah". (Graded weak.)
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Muadh ibn Anas: whoever eats food and says "Praise be to Allah who fed me this and provided it without any might or power from me", his past sins are forgiven.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Anas: when something distressed him the Prophet would say "O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining, in Your mercy I seek relief".
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Aisha: the Prophet used to take care to fast on Mondays and Thursdays.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: deeds are presented on Monday and Thursday, and the Prophet loved that his deeds be presented while he was fasting.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani: whoever provides a fasting person with food to break his fast gets the same reward as the fasting person, without reducing his reward.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Qays ibn Talq, from his father: asked about touching one's private part, the Prophet said it is only a piece of one's flesh.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Kabshah bint Kab: Abu Qatadah let a cat drink from the water she poured for his wudu, and said the Prophet said cats are not impure, they are among those who go about among you.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah reported the Prophet said whoever treads a path seeking knowledge, Allah makes the way to Paradise easy for him
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Umar said the Prophet forbade fasting on the day you break your fast and the day you eat the meat of your sacrifices
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Mu'adh reported the Prophet said Allah's right on His servants is that they worship Him alone and associate nothing with Him, and the servants' right on Allah is that He does not punish the one who associates nothing with Him
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Sahl ibn Sa'd reported a woman offered herself in marriage, and a man who owned little was told to look for something even an iron ring, and was married to her for the Qur'an he knew
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Al-Bara reported the Prophet said on the day of Eid al-Adha that the first thing we do is pray and then return to slaughter, and whoever slaughtered before the prayer, it is only meat given to his family
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Said reported the Prophet said the Friday bath is compulsory for every adult male Muslim, with cleaning the teeth with siwak and using perfume if available
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah reported the Prophet said whoever bathes on Friday like the bath of janabah and goes early to the prayer, it is as if he offered a camel in sacrifice, and the reward lessens for each later hour
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah reported the Prophet said the best day on which the sun has risen is Friday, on which Adam was created
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha asked the Prophet what to say if she knew the Night of Al-Qadr, and he taught her to say O Allah, You are Pardoning, You love pardon, so pardon me
hadith.grader: Darussalam
